_doc: Settings for trigger.mjs. Override path with MATTER_TRIGGER_CONFIG.

device.label: Claude
device._vendorIdDoc: 0xFFF1 / 0x8000 are the Matter test vendor/product IDs for uncertified devices.

_collectLevelMsDoc: How long after ON to wait for a brightness that came with the same command.
_resetDoc: Switch back OFF this long after ON, so the next routine fires again. Must exceed collectLevelMs.
_onTriggerDoc: Command run on ON without a brightness. Empty array = log only.
_onTriggerWithLevelDoc: Command run on ON with a brightness; {percent} is 0-100.
